subject: Custodial snapshot retention proposal for NovaGene forensics request
content:
From: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@novagene.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: security@novagene.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Custodial snapshot retention ask — expedited forensic window

Hi Markus,

Thanks for taking this. We need a short-term accommodation for custodial snapshots while our internal incident review runs and during an upcoming SOC 2 re-audit. Specifically:

- Request: preserve tenant-scoped ephemeral session snapshots and request-level logs for the tenant "novagene-prod" for 180 days from collection (instead of standard 30-day TTL).
- Scope: metadata + request logs + kv-cache snapshots. No PII extraction requested; Novagene team will handle redaction review.
- Why: evidence for an integrity investigation and to meet evidence sampling for our SOC 2 auditor.

Please confirm whether Redwood can:
1) Create a custodial snapshot and hold for 180 days under a documented chain-of-custody;
2) Provide an evidence manifest and a signed attestation that snapshots were unmodified; and
3) Deliver sample exports (CSV + MD5 checksums) and a packing list for auditor review.

We'd like an initial response by end of day next Monday (Nov 23) to present to our security lead.

Thanks,
Olivia Turner
Head of Security Operations
NovaGene

---
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@novagene.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 12:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Custodial snapshot retention ask — expedited forensic window

Olivia — thanks for the clear ask. We can support a temporary custodial hold; below is an initial plan and open questions. I'll coordinate with infra and legal and loop Neha/Ben for delivery.

High-level proposal (initial):
- Create a tenant-scoped snapshot for novagene-prod capturing request logs, service metadata, and the runtime KV snapshot as of snapshot time.
- Place the artifact in an encrypted evidence bucket under Redwood's evidence escrow with access restrictions and retention flags set to 180 days.
- Produce an evidence manifest containing file-level checksums (SHA256), capture time, and the operator identity.
- Provide a signed attestation (PDF) confirming unmodified custody.

Open questions for Novagene (helpful to confirm):
- Do you need continuous rolling captures (daily) or a single point-in-time snapshot?
- Are there any additional artifacts auditors require (traces, raw shard dumps)?
- Will Novagene execute the redaction review, or should Redwood run PII masking prior to export?

Attachments: initial custodial snapshot workplan and a quick checklist I created.
[Attachment: custodial_snapshot_workplan.xlsx (Excel, 72KB)]
[Attachment: Novagene_SOC2_Retention_Questionnaire.pdf (PDF, 480KB)]

I'll revert once Ben confirms operational runbook and Neha confirms legal/attestation wording.

Cheers,
Markus Klein
Director, Security & Compliance 
Redwood Inference

---
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@novagene.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:25:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Custodial snapshot retention ask — expedited forensic window

Hi Olivia / Markus — following up from infra and legal reviews. Below is an operational playbook we can commit to and the artifacts you should expect.

Operational playbook (Novagene custodial snapshot):
1) Scope confirmation call (30m) to lock scope and capture tenant IDs — scheduled after your confirmation.
2) Snapshot run: single point-in-time snapshot by default (we can schedule daily for up to 7 days if you request).
3) Artifact handling: snapshot stored encrypted (AES-256) in isolated evidence bucket; access limited to a named ops list; S3 object lock will be set with retention 180 days.
4) Manifest & attestation: we will generate a manifest (file list + SHA256 checksums), a chain-of-custody log (who created/ exported), and a signed attestation PDF (legal) stating the artifact is unchanged.
5) Export packaging: CSV exports for logs + README and checksums. If Novagene requests hashed raw shard files, we'll include those as separate artifacts.
6) Redaction: Redwood will not modify data content for integrity purposes. Novagene may request a redaction pass; if requested, we will produce a redaction report describing changes.

Turnaround and deliverables:
- Snapshot execution: within 3 business days after scope confirmation call.
- Manifest & checksums: within 24 hours after snapshot.
- Attestation PDF: within 2 business days after manifest.

Attachments included: finalized packing checklist and sample manifest template. Also adding a Drive folder link with the export templates and a DocuSign envelope to sign the temporary evidence retention addendum.
[Attachment: novagene-evidence-packing-list.pdf (PDF, 18KB)]

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cSnapshotPack_NovaGene
DocuSign (temporary retention addendum): https://app.docusign.com/embeddedSigning?eq=NOVAGENE_RETENTION

Notes on legal language we propose for the attestation: "Redwood Inference attests that the custodial snapshot for tenant 'novagene-prod' was created on <timestamp> and has remained in Redwood-controlled encrypted storage with object lock and access controls, and checksums presented in the manifest reflect the artifact state at the time of collection."

Please confirm: 1) single snapshot vs daily rolling; 2) whether Novagene wants raw shard exports; and 3) who will sign DocuSign (name and title).

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Counsel, Privacy & Security
Redwood Inference

---
From: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@novagene.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: security@novagene.com, legal@novagene.com
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 15:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Custodial snapshot retention ask — expedited forensic window

Neha / Markus — thanks, this is great and aligns with what our SOC auditor requested. Quick answers:

1) Single point-in-time snapshot is sufficient for now. If the auditor asks for daily samples we will request separately.
2) We do not need raw shard files initially — logs + KV snapshot + manifest are fine.
3) DocuSign will be signed by Rachel Li, Director, Legal (rachel.li@novagene.com).

Next steps per Novagene: schedule the scope call for Monday (Nov 30) 10:00 AM PT; Rachel will review the DocuSign packet afterward and sign. Once signed, please execute the snapshot and share manifest + attestation.

We appreciate the quick turnaround and the chain-of-custody detail — the auditor flagged that as a required control.

Best,
Olivia Turner
Head of Security Operations
NovaGene
